manuscript_excerpt: The conservation intervention was applied to one wetland and compared with one untreated wetland. Fifty quadrats per wetland were analyzed as independent intervention replicates.
source_record: All quadrats share the single site-level treatment assignment.
expected_disposition: Raise a unit-of-replication concern and calibrate inference to two sites.
rationale: Subsamples do not create independent treatment assignments.

manuscript_excerpt: Occurrences are reported under an older species name used during field identification.
source_record: GBIF identifies the manuscript name as a synonym of the accepted taxon with the same taxonomic concept.
expected_disposition: Do not flag a species mismatch. Preserve the synonym and accepted name.
rationale: Documented synonymy explains the name difference.

manuscript_excerpt: This record establishes the first occurrence inside the protected area.
source_record: The coordinate lies 300 meters inside the boundary, but reported coordinate uncertainty is 1 kilometer.
expected_disposition: Treat the inside-boundary claim as unresolved and request finer provenance.
rationale: The uncertainty radius crosses the relevant boundary.

manuscript_excerpt: The species has never occurred in the northern watershed.
source_record: The bounded public occurrence search returns no records and no systematic survey metadata.
expected_disposition: Do not infer absence. Ask for survey effort or a range source.
rationale: Database non-detection can reflect coverage and reporting gaps.
